description: External network egress allowlist. Deny by default. Adding entries requires Plan + Design + security review.
policy: Module group F (telemetry/cc-bridge/docs-code-scanner) and cc-regression (group E) must produce zero matches against blocked_patterns outside exempt_paths.

allowed_egress.rationale: Pre-existing OpenProject MCP integration (cycle-1 feature). Documented external dependency.

exempt_rationale: Test fixtures may mock external transport. Production node_modules NOT exempt (supply-chain risk, council security HIGH-2). OpenProject integration scripts (scripts/op-*) documented in allowed_egress.
